description: Inside an `analog` block or a `begin ... end`, the parser expected a statement (an assignment, a contribution `<+`, `if`, `case`, a loop, an event control, or a system task) and found something that cannot start one.
actions: Check the statement at the position shown for a typo in its first word.
Look at the source at the position shown, and at the end of the line before it: a syntax error is often noticed one token after the actual mistake.
